op.title: Just got my color TV installed.

replies.body: Cool, now tell us the picture size.

No!! You just don't get it!! It's a luxury to sit in a drooling stupor watching R*A*S*H* re-runs while being barraged by colors like a toddler hypnotized by its favorite toy! It's not like all cinematography in existence has been shot with monochrome in mind!
